title.suggested: Mace and Allen Plan Sparring Tour (Reprint)

summary.suggested: The Daily Missouri Democrat repeated its report that Tom Allen and Jem Mace, still in New Orleans, planned a sparring tour once Allen's arm healed, and that Mrs. Allen had gone to join him with his belt.

metadata.notes: Masthead reads Daily Democrat, Monday Morning, May 16, 1870. Text is identical to the May 15 item (article 402); likely a duplicate reprint.

facts.fact: Allen stayed in New Orleans recovering from the arm injury suffered against Mace; he and Mace planned an exhibition in New Orleans and then an extended sparring tour through the country
Mrs. Allen left St. Louis for New Orleans to join her husband, taking the belt presented to him by his St. Louis friends

notes: Duplicate of article 402 (same text, reprinted a day later); a human should decide whether to keep both. 'On Thursday' taken as May 12 from the original May 15 printing.
